
# Double Trouble Studio (DTS)

Website: https://www.dtsworld.in

## About

Double Trouble Studio (DTS), legally Double Trouble Studio Pvt. Ltd., is a Mumbai-based creative, digital marketing, public relations, celebrity management, event management, guest management, website development and AI video production agency.

DTS combines strategy, creativity, technology, media and talent partnerships to help brands build visibility, authority and measurable business growth across digital and offline channels.

## Core Services

- Celebrity Management
- Guest Management
- Event & Wedding Management
- Public Relations (PR)
- Digital Marketing
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Social Media Marketing
- Website Design & Development
- AI Video Production
- CGI Advertising & VFX
- Branding & Creative Strategy

## Industries Served

- Luxury Brands
